en_US.title: PDA Evidence Tier Label Rule
en_US.scanner: Presentation rule: PDA evidence uses tier labels for rumor, artifact, physical proof, receiver authority and ending record.
en_US.terminal: PDA LABELS: do not color truth as good/bad. Label custody strength, proof stage, spoiler gate and receiver pressure.
en_US.audio: The PDA should tell you how strong the proof is, not what to feel.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Evidence tier labels keep the codex readable across long campaigns without turning mystery into checklist morality.
en_US.external_site: In-game documents are organized by evidence strength and custody, not by quest-good or quest-bad labels.
en_US.field_note: PDA label record: evidence tier labels and glossary terms must remain readable, stable, and localization-safe.

en_US.title: Scanner Stage Copy Escalation Rule
en_US.scanner: Scanner copy escalates from safe classification to route risk to Atlas contamination only when evidence supports it.
en_US.terminal: SCAN STAGES: stage 0 classify, stage 1 route hint, stage 2 hazard, stage 3 custody, stage 4 Atlas repair-network relation.
en_US.audio: A scanner should get scared slowly and for reasons.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Scanner writing keeps horror earned: the same object becomes stranger only as the player's tool chain improves.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 reveals ecology and machine contamination through staged evidence, not instant lore dumps.
en_US.field_note: Scanner copy record: scan stages escalate from contact to evidence without dumping omniscient exposition.

en_US.title: Terminal Operator Surface Rule
en_US.scanner: Terminal rule: old colony terminals speak as operators, logs and systems, not omniscient lore narrators.
en_US.terminal: TERMINAL VOICE: clipped procedure, worn jokes, legal boilerplate, sensor confidence and failure stamps. No villain monologue.
en_US.audio: A terminal should sound like it was used by tired people.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Terminal surfaces carry human texture through procedure, not exposition speeches.
en_US.external_site: The colony is understood through work systems: pumps, queues, certifications and broken legal packets.
en_US.field_note: Terminal voice record: operator surfaces stay short, local, procedural, and tied to physical context.

en_US.title: Dossier Ending Record Layout Rule
en_US.scanner: Dossier rule: ending records show receiver, custody, proof state, Atlas continuity, player survival and debt outcome.
en_US.terminal: ENDING RECORD: never show a clean victory stamp. Show payload receiver, suppressed/open evidence, survival route and unresolved cost.
en_US.audio: The record does not congratulate you. It itemizes what changed hands.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Ending dossier layout makes outcomes comparable without reducing them to good/bad endings.
en_US.external_site: Spoiler pages should describe endings through custody and consequence, not moral score.
en_US.field_note: Dossier layout record: ending records preserve knowledge and consequence without turning into gear progression.
